name: Ataeric's Staff
summary: At the Sepulcher, Ataeric's Staff marks the archmage's defeat. Archmage Ataeric, a senior Dalaran wizard in Silverpine Forest, wielded it to command local ley lines.

sections.title: Trophy of the Sepulcher
sections.body: Shadow Priest Allister feared Dalaran's growing reach in magic and ordered Ataeric killed. He also demanded the staff. Once Ataeric was slain and the staff recovered, the concentrated ley energies sank back into dormancy. Carrying the staff to the Sepulcher marked a clear victory over Dalaran's ambitions. Yet power still lies latent in the earth, and the Forsaken remain watchful.

sections.title: A Conduit of Ley Magic
sections.body: Archmage Ataeric carried the staff to direct ley energies in southern Silverpine Forest. Dalaran sent him to awaken an ancient ley node near the borders of its territory. The staff helped him weave the vast currents around him, making the archmage a grave threat to nearby Forsaken settlements.

faq.q: Who does Ataeric's Staff belong to?
faq.answer: Archmage Ataeric, a senior Dalaran wizard stationed in Silverpine Forest, owned the staff. He was there to oversee the awakening of a powerful ley node.

faq.q: Why does Shadow Priest Allister want Ataeric's Staff?
faq.answer: Shadow Priest Allister at the Sepulcher wants the staff as proof that Archmage Ataeric is dead. He also seeks to break Dalaran's efforts to command the region's ley lines.

faq.q: What happens once the staff is taken from Archmage Ataeric?
aliases: what happens to the ley line
faq.answer: When Ataeric is slain and the staff taken, the ley energies Dalaran had woven dissipate and sink into dormancy. The immediate magical threat to the Forsaken ends.
Archmage Ataeric's body is found among other Dalaran mages and warders in southern Silverpine Forest, near Dalaran's presence. The staff is recovered from his body.

angles.text: For the Forsaken, recovering the staff checks Dalaran's growing hold over Silverpine's magical reserves and secures their western borders.
As a mage, you can see how Dalaran's archmagi use focused implements to reach ley nodes and stir them from dormancy.
